name: Youngtronics, LLC
old_description: Our facility’s two SMT production lines have supported PCB assembly and testing since 2005.
about:
Youngtronics, LLC operates a 6,000-square-foot, climate-controlled facility in Wixom, Michigan. The company moved into the building in 2005 and has run two surface-mount technology (SMT) production lines there since that year. Ownership details and founder names are not disclosed publicly.

The shop provides full-spectrum electronic contract manufacturing: PCB assembly using both SMT and through-hole processes (including fine-pitch down to 12 mm, BGA, micro-BGA, and mixed technology), quick-turn prototyping, low- to high-volume production, and turnkey or consignment material programs. Beyond the board, Youngtronics delivers box-build integration, wire-harness and cable fabrication, conformal coating, epoxy potting, and a range of test services—in-circuit, functional, and real-time X-ray inspection. The facility also supports PCB rework, repair, and first-article inspection.

Customers span medical and healthcare, education, transportation, energy and utilities, consumer electronics, defense, telecommunications, automotive, industrial, commercial, and aerospace sectors. The company notes ongoing affiliations with design houses to offer layout and engineering support across those industries.

Youngtronics emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certification, on-time delivery, and long-term customer partnerships as differentiators. The business was built to provide cost-effective, high-quality EMS with the flexibility to handle prototypes through full production runs from a single Midwest location.
